title: Manali, Kasol & Jibhi
reportingPoint: Majnu ka Tila, Delhi, at 7 PM on the departure evening (pickup from Chandigarh is also available). Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip; report 30 minutes early.
overview:
Three Himachal favourites in one trip: this **4 Nights / 5 Days** group trip leaves Majnu ka Tila, Delhi, at 7 PM every Friday (pickup from Chandigarh too) for an overnight journey to Manali.

Day 1 covers Hadimba Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road with a bonfire dinner. Day 2 heads to Solang Valley and Sissu via the Atal Tunnel, with zorbing, skiing, ATV rides and more at your own cost. Day 3 drives to Kasol for Manikaran Sahib, the Chalal hike and cafe hopping. Day 4 moves on to Jibhi for its waterfall, market and cafes. Day 5 drives to Jalori Pass via Shoja for a 4 km snow trek to Serolsar Lake, then descends to Aut for the overnight bus, reaching Delhi around 9 AM (tentative). Prices start at ₹14,000 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra); Christmas and New Year batches cost more.
highlights: Hadimba Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road
Solang Valley and the Atal Tunnel to Sissu (adventure activities at own cost)
Manikaran Sahib, the Chalal hike and Kasol cafes
Jibhi Waterfall, the local market and cafes
Jalori Pass to Serolsar Lake, a 4 km snow trek via Shoja

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi at 7 PM
itinerary.content:
Assemble at Majnu ka Tila, Delhi, at 7 PM (pickup from Chandigarh is also available) and meet your team captain and the group.
Depart for the overnight journey to Manali in an AC tempo traveller or bus.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: Reach Manali | Hadimba Temple | Old Manali | Mall Road
itinerary.content:
Reach Manali in the morning, check in at the hotel and freshen up.
Local sightseeing: Hadimba Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road.
Back to the hotel for dinner with a bonfire and light music.
Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley | Atal Tunnel | Sissu
itinerary.content:
After an early breakfast, head out for the day.
Head to Solang Valley and Sissu via the Atal Tunnel, a paradise for adventure lovers: zorbing, skiing, ATV rides, paragliding, ziplining and more (own cost).
Back to the hotel in the evening for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Manali to Kasol | Manikaran | Chalal
itinerary.content:
Wake up early, have breakfast and check out.
Check in at Kasol, visit Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara and its hot spring, then hike to Chalal for Parvati Valley views.
Evening cafe hopping and the local market.
Dinner and overnight stay in Kasol.

itinerary.title: Kasol to Jibhi | Jibhi Waterfall
itinerary.content:
Breakfast, check out and leave for Jibhi.
Check in, then visit Jibhi Waterfall, explore the local market and go cafe hopping.
Dinner and overnight stay in Jibhi.

itinerary.title: Jalori Pass snow trek to Serolsar Lake | Departure
itinerary.content:
Wake up early for the sunrise, then breakfast.
Drive to Jalori Pass via Shoja and trek 4 km to Serolsar Lake along a narrow track lined with tall trees.
Descend to Aut and board the overnight bus to Delhi.
Reach Delhi around 9 AM the next day (tentative). Trip ends.

includes: Stay: 2 nights in Manali, 1 night in Kasol and 1 night in Jibhi
AC tempo traveller, Innova or AC deluxe bus, as per group size
All local transfers and sightseeing as mentioned in the itinerary
excludes: Food and beverages not included in the package
Adventure activities in Solang and Sissu; 4x4 vehicle in snow; non-AC local vehicles
Costs from natural calamities or circumstances beyond our control
Any other expense not listed under the inclusions

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: The trip leaves Majnu ka Tila, Delhi, at 7 PM every Friday for an overnight journey to Manali. Pickup from Chandigarh is also available. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.

faqs.q: How much does the Manali, Kasol & Jibhi trip cost?
faqs.a: On regular dates: ₹14,000 per person on quad sharing, ₹14,500 on triple and ₹15,000 on double. Christmas and New Year batches: ₹15,000 quad, ₹16,000 triple and ₹17,000 double. 5% GST is extra.

2 nights in Manali, 1 night in Kasol and 1 night in Jibhi, 8 meals (4 breakfasts and 4 dinners), AC transport as per group size, all local transfers and sightseeing in the itinerary, a bonfire and music party and a tour curator.

faqs.q: Are the Solang Valley activities included?
faqs.a: No. Zorbing, skiing, ATV rides, paragliding, ziplining and other activities in Solang and Sissu are at your own cost, as is a 4x4 vehicle in snow.
The first two nights are in a hotel in Manali, the third in Kasol and the fourth in Jibhi. Extra mattresses are provided for triple and quad sharing.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat with a ₹3,000 advance per person (UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking) and pay the rest 24 hours before boarding. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
The ₹3,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances. There are no refunds for inclusions you don't use, and bookings can't be transferred.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack a down or main jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, outdoor shoes, a daypack and personal medication. The full list is under Things To Pack.

thingsToCarry: Valid government photo ID (no boarding without it)
